'''Star Tours Flight 119''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was scheduled to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1G at 1120 hours but it was delayed, moving its planned departure time from 1215 hours to 1235.
